nowweather.config.section.mapping.hint.en: How real weather becomes in-game weather

nowweather.config.section.time.hint.zh: 游戏内一天 = 真实 24 小时
nowweather.config.section.time.hint.en: One in-game day equals 24 real hours

nowweather.config.section.forecast.hint.zh: 本地预报的粒度与容差
nowweather.config.section.forecast.hint.en: Granularity and tolerance of the local forecast

nowweather.config.section.sync.hint.zh: 作用维度、客户端同步、与其它天气模组共存
nowweather.config.section.sync.hint.en: Target dimensions, client sync, and coexistence with other weather mods

nowweather.config.section.llm.hint.zh: AI 辅助推算天气 / 自然语言改配置（会产生费用）
nowweather.config.section.llm.hint.en: AI weather inference and natural-language config edits (costs money)

nowweather.config.section.debug.hint.zh: 排查「为什么拿不到天气」
nowweather.config.section.debug.hint.en: Diagnose why no weather is coming through

nowweather.config.entry.location_adcode..zh: 最精确，例如 330106 = 杭州西湖区；留空则用城市名
nowweather.config.entry.location_adcode..en: The most precise option, e.g. 330106 = Xihu District, Hangzhou. Leave empty to use the city name

nowweather.config.entry.location_city.hi.zh: 例如 杭州、北京；重名时建议改用 adcode
nowweather.config.entry.location_city.hi.en: e.g. Hangzhou, Beijing. If the name is ambiguous, use the adcode instead

nowweather.config.entry.location_coordin.en: latitude,longitude — e.g. 30.274,120.155. The most accurate option

nowweather.config.entry.location_useiplo.zh: 上面三项都留空时按请求方 IP 定位（专用服务器会定位到机房）
nowweather.config.entry.location_useiplo.en: Used when the three options above are empty; on a dedicated server this resolves to the data centre

nowweather.config.entry.location_announc.zh: 每隔刷新间隔（默认 20 分钟）巡检一次；同城静默更新坐标，跨市/跨省/跨境才提示
nowweather.config.entry.location_announc.en: Checked once per refresh interval (20 minutes by default); stays silent within the same city and only speaks up when you cross a city, province or border

nowweather.config.entry.api_providerid.h.zh: 留空 = 按优先级自动回退：caiyun(80) → openmeteo(90) → uapipro(100)；也可填 caiyun / openmeteo / uapipro / static 强制只用它
nowweather.config.entry.api_providerid.h.en: Empty = automatic fallback in priority order: caiyun(80) → openmeteo(90) → uapipro(100). Set caiyun / openmeteo / uapipro / static to force a single one

nowweather.config.entry.api_apikey.hint.zh: 形如 uapi-xxxxxxxx；不填也能用，填了配额更高
nowweather.config.entry.api_apikey.hint.en: Looks like uapi-xxxxxxxx. Optional, but a key raises your quota

nowweather.config.entry.api_caiyuntoken..zh: 推荐：雷达实测降水、1km 分辨率、自带云量与时区（最高优先级数据源）
nowweather.config.entry.api_caiyuntoken..en: Recommended: radar-measured precipitation, 1 km resolution, cloud cover and time zone included (highest-priority provider)

nowweather.config.entry.api_staleafterse.zh: 超过它就标记为缓存数据并在界面上提示
nowweather.config.entry.api_staleafterse.en: Past this age the data is marked as cached and flagged in the UI

nowweather.config.entry.api_requesttimeo.en: Raise it on a slow connection

nowweather.config.entry.api_openmeteogeo.zh: 用城市名去 Open-Meteo 解析经纬度（支持中文）
nowweather.config.entry.api_openmeteogeo.en: Resolve a city name to coordinates through Open-Meteo (Chinese names supported)

nowweather.config.entry.api_endpoint.hin.zh: 除非官方换域名，否则不要改
nowweather.config.entry.api_endpoint.hin.en: Do not change unless the official domain changes

nowweather.config.entry.api_openmeteoend.zh: 除非官方换域名，否则不要改
nowweather.config.entry.api_openmeteoend.en: Do not change unless the official domain changes

nowweather.config.entry.general_enabled..zh: 关掉后不再干预游戏天气（原版天气照常跑）
nowweather.config.entry.general_enabled..en: When off, NowWeather stops touching the weather and vanilla weather runs as usual

nowweather.config.entry.mapping_respectb.zh: ★ 强烈建议开：让群系的「正常温度范围」约束真实天气
nowweather.config.entry.mapping_respectb.en: ★ Strongly recommended: let each biome's normal temperature range constrain the real weather

nowweather.config.entry.mapping_raininte.zh: 降水强度 ≥ 它才真的下雨（0~1）
nowweather.config.entry.mapping_raininte.en: Precipitation intensity must reach this value (0–1) for it to actually rain

nowweather.config.entry.mapping_thunderi.zh: 雷电强度 ≥ 它才打雷（0~1）
nowweather.config.entry.mapping_thunderi.en: Thunder intensity must reach this value (0–1) for thunder to start

nowweather.config.entry.mapping_leavenet.en: Leave the Nether and End to vanilla

nowweather.config.entry.mapping_leavenet.zh: ★ 建议保持开启：这两个维度完全不动
nowweather.config.entry.mapping_leavenet.en: ★ Recommended: these dimensions are left completely untouched

nowweather.config.entry.mapping_seasonin.zh: 按季节改写群系的正常温度范围（Serene Seasons）
nowweather.config.entry.mapping_seasonin.en: Shift each biome's normal temperature range by season (Serene Seasons)

nowweather.config.entry.mapping_terraint.zh: ★ 平原数据搬到高原时按递减率/露点/气压订正，而不是直接用查询坐标的原始值
nowweather.config.entry.mapping_terraint.en: ★ When lowland data is moved to high ground, correct it by lapse rate, dew point and pressure instead of using the raw values

nowweather.config.entry.mapping_vanillaw.zh: 原版 /weather 的效果最多持续多久，到期后模组重新接管
nowweather.config.entry.mapping_vanillaw.en: How long a vanilla /weather effect may last before NowWeather takes over again

nowweather.config.entry.mapping_meterspe.zh: 地形订正的海拔换算；默认 8.0（MC 世界只有 384 格高）
nowweather.config.entry.mapping_meterspe.en: Elevation scaling for terrain correction; 8.0 by default (a Minecraft world is only 384 blocks tall)

nowweather.config.entry.mapping_seasonam.zh: 1.0 = 默认；0 = 关闭季节影响

nowweather.config.entry.mapping_offlinef.zh: 拿不到真实天气时按本地气候生成合理天气
nowweather.config.entry.mapping_offlinef.en: Generate plausible weather from the local climate when the real data cannot be fetched

nowweather.config.entry.mapping_offlined.zh: AUTO = 按气候推断；也可填 RAIN / CLEAR 等
nowweather.config.entry.mapping_offlined.en: AUTO infers it from the climate; RAIN / CLEAR and similar values also work

nowweather.config.entry.shaders_intensit.zh: 把连续的雨/雷强度写进 rainLevel，光影里毛毛雨与暴雨才有区别（降水占 0.75~1.00）
nowweather.config.entry.shaders_intensit.en: Writes continuous rain and thunder intensity into rainLevel so shaders can tell drizzle from a downpour (precipitation uses 0.75–1.00)

nowweather.config.entry.shaders_cloudtor.zh: 用真实云量压暗天色；开不开光影都生效（云量占 rainLevel 的 0.00~0.60）
nowweather.config.entry.shaders_cloudtor.en: Uses real cloud cover to darken the sky, with or without shaders (cloud cover uses rainLevel 0.00–0.60)

nowweather.config.entry.shaders_cloudrai.zh: 默认 0.60，同时也是光影包 NW_CLOUD_BAND 的契约值；改这里必须同步改光影包 Lib/IndividualFounctions/NowWeather.glsl 里的 NW_CLOUD_BAND，否则云量会对不上（调小则阴天到不了满云，调大则云量曲线被压缩）
nowweather.config.entry.shaders_cloudrai.en: 0.60 by default, and the contract value of NW_CLOUD_BAND in the shader pack. Change it and you must change NW_CLOUD_BAND in Lib/IndividualFounctions/NowWeather.glsl too, or the cloud cover stops lining up (lower it and overcast never reaches full cloud; raise it and the cloud curve gets squashed)

nowweather.config.entry.timesync_enabled.zh: 游戏内一天 = 真实 24 小时，钟点与所在地一致
nowweather.config.entry.timesync_enabled.en: One in-game day equals 24 real hours, and the clock matches your local time

nowweather.config.entry.timesync_timezon.zh: AUTO = 跟随天气接口；北京 480、纽约 -300；范围 -1080~1080
nowweather.config.entry.timesync_timezon.en: AUTO follows the weather API; Beijing 480, New York -300; range -1080 to 1080

nowweather.config.entry.timesync_interva.zh: 已废弃：服务端现在每刻都写一次
nowweather.config.entry.timesync_interva.en: Deprecated: the server now writes the time every tick

nowweather.config.entry.timesync_moonpha.en: Moon phase follows the real calendar

nowweather.config.entry.timesync_moonpha.zh: 让世界天数 % 8 对齐真实月相，中秋节才会是满月
nowweather.config.entry.timesync_moonpha.en: Aligns world day % 8 with the real moon phase, so the Mid-Autumn Festival really is a full moon

nowweather.config.entry.forecast_tickspe.zh: 时间同步下 1000 刻 = 1 小时
nowweather.config.entry.forecast_tickspe.en: With time sync on, 1000 ticks = 1 hour

nowweather.config.entry.forecast_skyfore.zh: 用真实云量与能见度驱动天色（阴天压暗、雾变浓）；关掉后天气照常同步，只是天色不再跟随云量
nowweather.config.entry.forecast_skyfore.en: Drives the sky from real cloud cover and visibility (overcast darkens, fog thickens). Turn it off and the weather still syncs — only the sky stops following the clouds

nowweather.config.entry.forecast_tempera.zh: 超出多少度才判定为「不合理」并修正
nowweather.config.entry.forecast_tempera.en: How far outside the normal range a temperature may drift before it is corrected

nowweather.config.entry.forecast_allowex.zh: 台风 / 强雷暴 / 沙尘暴 / 暴风雪 / 冰雹
nowweather.config.entry.forecast_allowex.en: Typhoons, severe thunderstorms, sandstorms, blizzards and hail

nowweather.config.entry.sync_synctoclien.zh: 客户端 HUD 与联动需要它
nowweather.config.entry.sync_synctoclien.en: The client HUD and integrations need it

nowweather.config.entry.sync_dimensions..zh: 逗号分隔，例如 minecraft:overworld,minecraft:the_nether；填 none 或 - 清空
nowweather.config.entry.sync_dimensions..en: Comma-separated, e.g. minecraft:overworld,minecraft:the_nether. Use none or - to clear

nowweather.config.entry.sync_fixedbiomei.zh: 调试用，例如 minecraft:desert；留空 = 按玩家实际所在群系
nowweather.config.entry.sync_fixedbiomei.en: Debug only, e.g. minecraft:desert. Empty = use the biome the player is actually in

nowweather.config.entry.compat_yieldtoot.zh: ★ 检测到别的模组在管天气时自动让出控制权
nowweather.config.entry.compat_yieldtoot.en: ★ Automatically yield control when another mod is already managing the weather

nowweather.config.entry.compat_weather2d.zh: 指挥 Weather2 生成风暴
★ 用真实/推算天气决定要不要起沙尘暴/雪暴，Weather2 只负责渲染
nowweather.config.entry.compat_weather2d.en: ★ Real or inferred weather decides whether to raise a sandstorm or blizzard; Weather2 only renders it

nowweather.config.entry.compat_yieldtomo.zh: 留空/填 none = 用内置名单（Weather2 / 项目大气 等）
nowweather.config.entry.compat_yieldtomo.en: Empty or none uses the built-in list (Weather2, Project Atmosphere and others)

nowweather.config.entry.llm_enabled.hint.zh: ★ 本项目唯一会产生费用的功能，默认关闭
nowweather.config.entry.llm_enabled.hint.en: ★ The only feature in this mod that costs money; off by default

nowweather.config.entry.llm_apikey.hint.zh: 例如 DeepSeek 的 sk-...；不会写进日志
nowweather.config.entry.llm_apikey.hint.en: e.g. DeepSeek's sk-...; never written to the log

nowweather.config.entry.llm_thinking.hin.zh: 会显著增加输出 token（=成本），默认关
nowweather.config.entry.llm_thinking.hin.en: Significantly increases output tokens (and cost); off by default

nowweather.config.entry.llm_maxtokens.hi.en: Keeps the model from rambling (1200 by default)

nowweather.config.entry.llm_weatherdaily.zh: 每天一次 AI 天气
24 小时内不会重复调用（省成本硬上限）
nowweather.config.entry.llm_weatherdaily.en: Never calls twice within 24 hours (a hard cost cap)

nowweather.config.entry.llm_allowconfige.zh: 只允许改白名单内、且通过同一套范围校验的项
nowweather.config.entry.llm_allowconfige.en: Only whitelisted entries that pass the same range checks can be changed

nowweather.config.entry.debug_logprovide.zh: 排查「为什么拿不到天气」时打开
nowweather.config.entry.debug_logprovide.en: Turn this on when diagnosing why no weather is coming through

nowweather.config.entry.debug_announcewe.zh: 每次天气切换在聊天栏说一句
nowweather.config.entry.debug_announcewe.en: Prints one chat line every time the weather changes

nowweather.config.entry.hud_enabled.hint.zh: 在游戏界面上显示真实天气
nowweather.config.entry.hud_enabled.hint.en: Shows the real weather on screen

nowweather.config.entry.hud_showinchat.h.zh: 打开聊天框（按 T）时左上角显示模组运行信息
nowweather.config.entry.hud_showinchat.h.en: Shows the mod's status in the top-left corner while the chat screen is open (T by default)

nowweather.config.entry.hud_showindebugs.zh: 默认关：原版 F3 右栏很挤
nowweather.config.entry.hud_showindebugs.en: Off by default: vanilla's F3 right column is already crowded

nowweather.config.entry.hud_corner.hint.en: Which corner of the screen the HUD docks to

nowweather.config.entry.hud_background.h.en: Easier to read against bright scenes

nowweather.config.entry.hud_showlocation.zh: 地区行显示在 HUD 上（省 / 市 / 区，来自真实天气数据）
nowweather.config.entry.hud_showlocation.en: Show the location line on the HUD (province / city / district, taken from the real weather data)

nowweather.config.entry.hud_showtemperat.zh: HUD 上显示气温（跟随真实天气，并会按本地气候修正）
nowweather.config.entry.hud_showtemperat.en: Show temperature on the HUD (follows the real weather and is adjusted to the local climate)

nowweather.config.entry.hud_showhumidity.en: Show relative humidity on the HUD

nowweather.config.entry.hud_showwind.hin.zh: HUD 上显示风向与风力等级
nowweather.config.entry.hud_showwind.hin.en: Show wind direction and Beaufort scale on the HUD

nowweather.config.entry.hud_showforecast.zh: HUD 上显示预报行（下一段天气与温度）
nowweather.config.entry.hud_showforecast.en: Show the forecast line on the HUD (next weather slot and its temperature)

nowweather.config.entry.hud_skymood.hint.zh: 暴晒/阴沉/雨雷/雾霾/沙尘各有不同天色
nowweather.config.entry.hud_skymood.hint.en: Clear, overcast, stormy, hazy and dusty weather each tint the sky differently

nowweather.config.entry.hud_forecastline.zh: HUD 预报最多显示几行；0 = 不显示预报。行数越多占的屏幕越高
nowweather.config.entry.hud_forecastline.en: How many forecast lines the HUD shows at most; 0 hides the forecast. More lines take up more screen height

nowweather.config.entry.hud_onlywhenhold.zh: 喜欢干净界面可以打开
nowweather.config.entry.hud_onlywhenhold.en: Turn it on if you prefer a clean screen

nowweather.config.subtitle.zh: 用真实天气驱动 Minecraft · v%s

nowweather.config.hint.save_required.zh: §7开关点一下立刻生效；文本框改完点「保存」才写入。
nowweather.config.hint.save_required.en: §7Toggles apply immediately; typed values are written when you press Save.

nowweather.config.status.changed.en: %s → %s (press Save to write it to disk)

nowweather.config.status.page_restored.zh: §e本页已恢复默认值（还没写盘，点「保存」才生效）。
nowweather.config.status.page_restored.en: §eThis page has been reset to defaults (not on disk until you press Save).

nowweather.config.error.boolean.zh: 只能是 true / false（或 开 / 关）

nowweather.config.error.not_toggle.en: This option is not a toggle

nowweather.config.error.not_enum.en: This option is not an enum

nowweather.config.entry.shaders_rainamou.zh: 精调「雨下得多大」。乘在降水强度上再编码进光影的降水区间：0.5 = 中雨看起来像小雨；1.0 = 原样；2.0 = 小雨看起来像中雨；0.0 = 视觉上完全不画雨幕（天气本身仍然是「在下雨」）。因为只改降水区间内部的分量，编码值恒 ≥ 0.75，不会掉进缓冲区，所以不会出现「说下雨却一滴都不画」。
nowweather.config.entry.shaders_rainamou.en: Fine-tune how heavy the rain looks. Multiplied into the precipitation intensity before it is encoded into the shader's rain band: 0.5 makes moderate rain look light, 1.0 is unchanged, 2.0 makes light rain look moderate, and 0.0 draws no rain overlay at all (the weather is still "raining"). Only the value inside the precipitation band is changed, so the encoded value never drops below 0.75 — you cannot end up with "says it is raining but nothing renders".

nowweather.config.entry.shaders_snowamou.zh: 精调「雪下得多大」，机制与降雨量倍率相同，只作用于冻结形态的降水（小雪 / 中雪 / 大雪 / 暴风雪 / 雨夹雪 / 冻雨 / 冰雹）。想让雪更薄或更厚改这里，不用动降雨量倍率。
nowweather.config.entry.shaders_snowamou.en: Fine-tune how heavy the snow looks. Same mechanism as the rain amount scale, but applied only to frozen precipitation (light/moderate/heavy snow, blizzard, sleet, freezing rain, hail). Use this rather than the rain scale to make snow thinner or thicker.
